§13 p5.text: Our aesthetics (§ 1), just like logic, her older sister by birth, consists of (I) a THEORETICAL first part that is instructive and general, teaching (1) about matters and potential thoughts HEURISTICALLY (chapter 1), (2) about lucid organization, METHODOLOGY (chapter 2), and (3) about the signs of what is thought and organized beautifully, SEMIOTICS (chapter 3); and (II) a PRACTICAL second part that is applied and particular.
